kind: simulated teaching spectrum, not experimental data
assumptions: Neutral mass and carbon count are abstract model inputs, not an assigned molecular formula or named compound.
Only carbon isotopes vary; all other atoms and added protons are fixed isotopically.
Independent carbon isotope probabilities; the representative abundance is held fixed.
Equal response per molecule for displayed isotopologues; peak heights are relative to k=0, not total probability.
Only k=0,1,2 are displayed; higher isotope classes still exist in the probability model.
Each peak is Gaussian with the same FWHM; no noise, interference, saturation, or baseline is simulated.
A constant additive m/z-coordinate offset is applied to all displayed peaks; this is not a universal model of calibration error.
Binding-energy mass corrections are neglected at the stated teaching precision.
